author: GamingBolt
description:
For all its faults and whatever is going on at Halo Studios, you have to admit – Halo: Campaign Evolved can be a very pretty game. With the development team shifting over to Unreal Engine 5, there's a photorealistic feel to Bungie's classic art direction, one that provides a stunning experience, even with a few caveats.

Of course, the question remains: Which platform is the best, and if you're not playing on PC, what's the console of choice? The answers may or may not surprise you.
title: Halo Campaign Evolved Looks Great On PS5 Pro, But What About PS5, Xbox Series X And PC?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy has a lot riding on its ambitious effort to bring a fresh new perspective and mechanical direction to a franchise that has primarily relied on stealth and immersive storytelling to push its narrative forward. 

It's also a departure that takes us through time and space, spanning a prequel timeline that dives further into the past to lend us the perspective of ancient heroes and a potential explanation for the story’s more supernatural elements. 

Add in a combat system that puts you front and center, with everything you need to make felling your foes seem like poetry, and you’ve got a game that’s flying high, and perhaps a little too close to the sun. 

But after our hands on and other impressions have dived deep into a section of it, we think this one’s got potential. Join us as we tell you more about why we think that’s the case.
title: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy Might Be 2026's Biggest Sleeper Hit - HERE’S WHY

author: GamingBolt
description:
At this point, you could look at it as neither side willing to budge, but I think PlayStation has already moved on. Like a breakup that only it knew about and which happened years before fans finally felt the effects. And as corny as it sounds, the fact that it knew there would be such significant backlash and carries - regardless of whether it goes away today, tomorrow, next week, next year or never - is a sign of the times.

Maybe it really won't matter to the majority when the PlayStation 6 is announced and costs almost $1000 because the graphics are so pretty, and it runs Grand Theft Auto 6 in native 8K at 120 FPS. It may not even matter to that same subset of people when Intergalactic gets its first gameplay deep dive and looks fantastic, irony of a far future with physical music discs notwithstanding.
title: Is PlayStation Losing the Digital-Only Argument? The PSN Outage Is One Reason Why
